description: This file defines API endpoints related to emoji reactions in a sports live stream platform backend using FastAPI. It includes routes for listing emojis, submitting reactions, and fetching reaction summaries, utilizing repositories and models for data handling.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of available emojis for reactions, including total count and page info.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles submission of an emoji reaction for a live event, updates counts, and broadcasts the update.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Fetches emoji reaction summary for a specific event.
